Subject: Request: service-account SCIM & SAML samples for SOC2 review

Hi Jasmine,

We are kicking off the SOC 2 in-scope evidence collection for NovaMed. To complete the access-control verification for service accounts and machine-to-machine flows we need the following artifacts from Redwood (scope: production tenant for novamed.redwood.com):

1) SCIM delta export for accounts flagged as "service-account" (role attribute or tag) for the period 2026-08-01 -> 2026-09-20. CSV preferred; include timestamp, actor, operation (create/update/delete), and attributes changed.
2) 5-10 example SAML assertion samples for service accounts / non-human principals that authenticated in-production in the same date range. Assertions should include Issuer/SP EntityID, NameID (redacted), assertion timestamp, and audience. Redact PII but keep structural fields.
3) A short README describing how service accounts are labeled in SCIM (attribute names/locations), retention policy for assertion logs, and who has access to the raw exports.

Can you deliver these artifacts by Tuesday, 28 Sep? If you need to redact anything, please provide the redaction log (what was removed & why). Also let us know if staged/test-only accounts should be excluded.

Thanks — attaching our evidence checklist for reference.

Regards,
Marta Alvarez
Senior Auditor — BrightAudits
[Attachment: brightaudits_evidence_checklist.pdf]
